story.zh: 为报兄弟之仇，刘备不顾众文武的反对，倾全国兵力向东开拨，一场大战在所难免。
story.en: To avenge his sworn brother, Liu Bei ignores the opposition of his civil and military officials, mobilizing all of his realm's troops to march east. A great war is now inevitable.

trigger.zh: 刘备、张飞、诸葛亮、赵云、孙权、陆逊存活，关羽死亡。刘备势力至少10人，孙权势力至少8人。成都、汉中属刘备，江陵属孙权。
trigger.en: Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, Zhuge Liang, Zhao Yun, Sun Quan, and Lu Xun are alive, Guan Yu is dead. Liu Bei's Faction has at least 10 members, and Sun Quan's Faction has at least 8 members. Chengdu and Hanzhong belong to Liu Bei, and Jiangling belongs to Sun Quan.

forbidden.zh: 主角是范疆、张达时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Fan Jiang or Zhang Da.

participate.en: 【Belong to Liu Bei's or Sun Quan's Faction】

defy.en: 【<Liu Bei's Faction> defeats the Wu forces!】

force.zh: 刘备身为君主并占领<成都><汉中>
force.en: Liu Bei is Ruler and occupies <Chengdu><Hanzhong>

force.zh: 张飞、赵云、诸葛亮回归刘备势力
force.en: Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, and Zhuge Liang return to Liu Bei's Faction.

force.zh: 孙权身为君主并占领<江陵>
force.en: Sun Quan is a Ruler and occupies <Jiangling>
Lu Xun returns to Sun Quan's Faction
